highlights.headline: COP31: Climate deal 'not adopted,' summit president says
highlights.summary: The summit was extended as nations worked to reach a deal, but they couldn't agree on including fossil fuels. European nations, small island states and activists have criticized oil-producing countries for the impasse.

highlights.headline: COP31 Bulletin Day 13: Germany rejects text moments before plenary meeting
highlights.summary: "We do not accept the text as it is", German minister Carsten Schneider told reporters before entering what should be the closing plenary The post COP31 Bulletin Day 13: Germany rejects text moments before plenary meeting appeared first on Climate Home News.

highlights.headline: EU and Indonesia sign trade deal
highlights.summary: A deal covering 730 million people promises lower tariffs and new investment opportunities as the European Union seeks to diversify trade ties amid growing global economic tensions.

items.title: New EU budget proposal aims at tax gobal tech giants
items.description: European Council President Antonio Costa has proposed a smaller EU budget for 2028-2034, including a 3% tax on major digital firms to ease member states' contributions. France has already rejected the plan as inadequate.
